title: Disentangling Question, Response, and Verifier Languages in Multilingual P(True) Self-Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model is asked whether its own answer is correct, three languages are involved: that of the question, that requested for the answer, and that of the verifier instruction asking for the judgment. Multilingual confidence evaluations seldom separate the three. We vary them independently in a six-language factorial design with ten open-weight models (3B-14B) on LSQA, MMMLU and TriviaQA, holding each answer fixed across verifier languages and measuring confidence with a first-token P(True) probe. The three languages move different parts of the evaluation: which of them governs accuracy depends on the benchmark, matching the response language to the question or verifier language sharpens discrimination but not calibration, and the verifier language alone shifts calibration error by up to 0.04 without changing accuracy. The scorer matters as well: an unvalidated judge would have shrunk the MMMLU English-Hindi accuracy gap from 0

translated_title: 解耦多语言 P(True) 自我评估中的问题语言、回答语言与验证语言
translated_abstract: 当语言模型被问及自己的答案是否正确时，涉及三种语言：问题的语言、要求回答所用的语言，以及要求做出判断的验证指令所用的语言。多语言置信度评估很少将这三者区分开来。我们在一个六语言因子设计中，使用十个开源权重模型（3B-14B），在 LSQA、MMMLU 和 TriviaQA 数据集上独立变化这三种语言，并在不同验证语言下保持每个答案固定，通过首个 token 的 P(True) 探针测量置信度。这三种语言影响评估的不同部分：哪种语言决定准确性取决于所用的基准测试；将回答语言与问题语言或验证语言相匹配可以提升区分度但无法改善校准；而仅验证语言本身就能使校准误差偏移多达 0.04 而不改变准确性。评分器同样重要：一个未经验证的评分器会使 MMMLU 上英语与印地语的准确率差距从 0（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过六语言因子设计首次将多语言自我评估中的问题语言、回答语言与验证语言解耦，发现三者分别影响评估的不同环节——准确性取决于基准、语言匹配提升区分度但不改善校准、验证语言独立偏移校准误差，同时强调评分器验证的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles question, response, and verifier languages in multilingual P(True) self-evaluation through a six-language factorial design, showing that the three languages differentially affect accuracy, discrimination, and calibration, and that the verifier language alone shifts calibration error by up to 0.04 without changing accuracy.
